title: Carbon Management
question: How much can different carbon-management approaches contribute?
method: Book-based rates, stocks, shared constraints and adjustable assumptions.
note: Worked scenarios from Counting Carbon; explore the resource and deployment assumptions.

title: Claim Checker
question: What does a claim in cars, flights or trees mean in tonnes?
method: Published equivalence factors and explicit annualised tree assumptions.
note: Comparisons depend on units and time period.

title: Carbon Time Machine
question: Where does a quantity of carbon fit in the longer story?
method: Atmospheric CO₂ history and emissions comparisons.
note: Compare quantities against observed history and annual emissions rates.

title: Reisa National Park
question: How do climate indicators change across future periods?
method: CNRM, ICHEC and IPSL model cases; supplied park grid and 1970–1990 baseline.
note: CLAP / Interreg Aurora. Interpret the screening categories alongside the stated thresholds and local evidence.

title: Pasvik Nature Reserve
question: Which changes matter for river access, birdlife and fire indicators?
method: Park-scale indicators, model cases and future-minus-baseline changes.
note: CLAP / Interreg Aurora attribution; original threshold assumptions are explained.

title: Two Weeks of Warm Nights
question: Where are sustained warm-night spells becoming more frequent?
method: ERA5-Land; 14-night spells at selected minimum-temperature thresholds.
note: 1981–2000 versus 2005–2024. Results describe grid-scale climate conditions.

title: Marine heatwaves
question: How does heatwave-category risk vary by coastal zone and month?
note: April–September 2025 snapshot. Original five-six-hourly-sample rule retained and labelled.

title: Seasonal snow depth
question: How wide is the forecast range for a resort or location?
method: ECMWF seasonal ensemble; five percentiles and native-grid point queries.
note: Archived December–May example; issue date unverified.

title: Good Summer Index
question: How has the Good Summer Index varied at a chosen location?
method: Supplied 1980–2024 annual fields, linear trends and component correlations.
note: An index devised by Richard Davy. The component relationships and trend calculation are explained in the tool.
